content: The World Health Organization (WHO) has published guidelines for the non-surgical management of chronic primary low back pain in adults, specifically targeting primary and community care settings. These guidelines are accompanied by a supplementary document, Web Annex E, which provides a detailed list of clinical trials categorized by intervention type. The electronic version of this publication is identified by ISBN 978-92-4-008571-8 and is copyrighted by WHO in 2023.
